character: Road course built in the infield and banking of Homestead-Miami Speedway, mixing tight infield technical corners with fast sweepers. No widely-documented corner names exist for this layout, so turns are numbered generically.
sources: https://www.racingcircuits.info/north-america/usa/homestead-miami-speedway.html ; https://www.iracing.com/tracks/homestead-miami-speedway/ No community-established corner names were found for this road course layout — generic Turn-N labels used deliberately.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.type: fast sweeper off the front straight
corners.technique: Commit with smooth steering, carry speed into the infield
corners.trap: Over-slowing and giving up momentum early in the lap

corners.name: Turn 3
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed in and running out of track

corners.name: Turn 6
corners.technique: Firm braking, late apex, prioritise a clean exit
corners.trap: Early apex compromises the exit and the following section

corners.name: Turn 10
corners.type: fast sweeper leading toward the oval banking rejoin
corners.technique: Commit through the corner, use the banking to carry speed
corners.trap: Hesitating on the merge back onto the banking costs significant time
